newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - S&P places Boral on negative watch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - S&P places Boral on negative watch.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said it has placed Boral Ltd's A/A-1 long-term and short term credit rating on creditwatch with negative implications following the release of its annual results earlier on Thursday.
Boral reported a 30 percent fall in its net profit for the year to June 30 to A$205.69 million. The company also cut its final dividend to 7.5 cents a share from 10 cents a share.
"Boral's results indicate greater earnings cyclicality and vulnerability to a single market than factored into the ratings," Standard and Poor's (S&P) said in a statement.
S&P said Boral's margins and returns had been reduced significantly because of the decline in housing construction activity in Australia.

"Boral has a leading position in the Australian building and construction materials markets, a growing presence in Australian gas production and distribution, sizeable U.S. building materials operations, and relatively small-scale operations in Asia and Europe," S&P said.
S&P said Boral's likely business and financial profile, as well as its performance outlook would be key determinants of the rating.
"If adjusted, Boral's ratings are unlikely to fall below A-minus/A-2," the ratings agency said.
At 2.28 p.m. (0428 GMT), Boral shares were five cents higher at A$3.06.
